links.launch_gate: Fresh owner, aggregate-cap, memory, S3-prefix and source-identity checks; run only alongside the named n43/n44 D4 tail and n50/n51 bounded-D4 panel.

question: Does the published n45 polynomial04 D4 seed lift to an independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds a fresh exact solution count of zero under a separate 8 GiB native cap?

claims.text: An independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds the freshly enumerated solution count certifies LFD >=6 for the exact named Boolean presentation.

arms.description: Stream and recheck D4 seed, enumerate exact solutions, run checkpoint-capable D5 producer and original independent checker.
Fresh exact count for the identical retained input; require agreement with historical zero before D5.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No known degree-six detection control. The unchanged qualified checkpoint worker passed real-cloud source/restore controls. Non-detection gives no upper bound.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Separate frozen export-guard controls reject corrupt state, wrong identities, existing output and insufficient capacity; local worker count-equality fixtures emit no LFD bound. No population arm inferred.

factors.name: input

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Exact checkpoint worker bundle, producer, guard, original checker and exact counter pinned by manifest.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One 123 GiB local host with an 8 GiB native RLIMIT, 8 GiB host admission reserve and a per-run lock. Concurrent owners are exactly the existing 14 GiB n43/n44 D4 tail and 27 GiB n50/n51 bounded-D4 panel; declared caps plus host reserve total 57 GiB. The 5,012,258,947-byte source-derived envelope is an allocation estimate, not measured RSS.

factors.name: stage
factors.how: Count and seed acceptance required before D5; no inference from incomplete later stages.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

primary.name: accepted D5 codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq only after original independent checker acceptance; absent if no accepted certificate.
primary.source: result.json certified_codimension_lower_bound only when status certificate_verified

secondary.name: exhaustive Boolean solution count
secondary.definition: Fresh count from the pinned native counter; no copied historical value is a new measurement.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Event-driven save after each seed chunk and completed closure round, plus export-ready state. Conditional S3 publication and full readback precede local prune. Startup/output are accounted under a 32 GiB run directory with a 512 MiB reserve; host admission reserves 8 GiB. No time-based checkpoint interval guarantee.

stopping_rules.rule: One named 21600-second local attempt, no automatic retry. Preserve every checkpoint and terminal outcome; stop on resource/checker/count failure, projection killing1, or export deferral. A later restore requires a separately reconciled launch receipt under the same frozen request/context.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

Launch only after fresh verification of the two named D4 owners, aggregate declared caps and host reserve, MemAvailable, empty checkpoint prefix, published seed identity and no other frontier owner. No automatic retry.

invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

decision_rule.text: At any accepted degree d, exact_count < checked_codimension establishes LFD>=d+1; reaching6 requires an accepted degree5 certificate and this strict inequality.

inputs: SHA-bound published n45 polynomial04 D4 certificate
outputs: Stage transcripts, exact count, independently checked D5 certificate or explicit inconclusive outcome, immutable S3 checkpoints and full-readback acknowledgments.

graphs: Per-instance D5 outcomes with unknown cells explicit; no runtime graph

inadmissible: Calling a killed constant a proved upper bound.
Calling native output certified before original checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD>=6 without accepted D5 map and strict count inequality.
Replacing original capped dense-engine records with cascade outcomes.
Treating a lower-degree accepted stage as degree-five completion.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.
Allocation source review and qualified identical certificate operations. No novelty or performance claim.
